== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ア'ウァア'ゥア'ウウ</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーンにしか配備できないが、そこからなら好きなところへ移動できる。他のタスケン・レイダーと同じ位置にいるなら、戦闘運命数を引けない場合も、1枚引ける。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">タスケン・レイダー部族のリーダー。機械を恐れない。優れた狩人にして銃の名手。水を奪いにモイスチャー・ファームを襲撃する。不用心な旅行者を求めてジャンドランドの荒地を徘徊する。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[URoRRuR'R'R]].

'''Lore''' — Leader of a Tusken Raider tribe. Unafraid of machines. A skilled hunter and marksman. Raids moisture farms for water. Roams the Jundland Wastes seeking unwary travelers.

'''Game text''' — May deploy only on Tatooine, but from there may move anywhere. If at the same location as another Tusken Raider, may draw one battle destiny even when otherwise unable to.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The Japanese face adds that after deploying on Tatooine he may move anywhere. The English original does not print that clause. English says same site. Japanese says same location.<ref>[[:File:ANH-D-urorrurrr.gif|Original English face]], [[URoRRuR'R'R]].</ref>
